authScheme: First-run wizard, in THIS exact order, every POST with Content-Type: application/json (a missing/wrong Content-Type is 415) and each answering 204: (1) POST /Startup/Configuration {UICulture, MetadataCountryCode, PreferredMetadataLanguage}; (2) POST /Startup/User {Name, Password}; (3) POST /Startup/RemoteAccess {EnableRemoteAccess:true, EnableAutomaticPortMapping:false}; (4) POST /Startup/Complete {}. CRITICAL QUIRK, verified live on 10.11: POST /Startup/User returns 404 unless a GET /Startup/User was issued first in the session — the GET primes the route. So on the create-admin operation set captureUrl:"/Startup/User" (the engine GETs captureUrl before it POSTs, which primes it) or otherwise GET /Startup/User immediately before. Also: the wizard endpoints 404/503 while the server is still loading and right after any container restart — wait until GET /System/Info/Public returns 200 before starting, and never recreate the container mid-wizard (do any container change, e.g. adding a media mount, BEFORE the wizard). After Complete, StartupWizardCompleted becomes true and every request needs an API key in the 'X-Emby-Token' header. To mint one: POST /Users/AuthenticateByName {Username, Pw} MUST carry the client-identification header Authorization: MediaBrowser Client="Miro", Device="miro", DeviceId="miro", Version="1" (no Token — returns 400/401 without this header, and 401 if the admin was never actually created because the /Startup/User 404 was ignored); the response's AccessToken is a session token usable as X-Emby-Token — keep it with storeResponseField {field:"AccessToken", ref:"extension.jellyfin.session_token"}. A permanent key: POST /Auth/Keys?app=Miro with that token (204), then GET /Auth/Keys lists Items[].AccessToken. Libraries: GET/POST /Library/VirtualFolders; sessions: GET /Sessions; system: GET /System/Info.
